'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli incursions in Tulkarm]]
***An [[Israel]]i [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] kills three [[Palestinians]] in [[Tulkarm]] in the [[West Bank]], during a raid where [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] soldiers set fire to civilian homes and used bulldozers to destroy residential areas. ***Eleven [[Palestinian]]s are killed and six others are injured in an [[Israel]]i strike on a residential building in [[Beit Lahiya]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://p.dw.com/p/4jmKE (DW)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***A ferry carrying 30 fuel tanks sinks in the [[Port Kavkaz|port of Kavkaz]], in [[Krasnodar Krai]], [[Russia]], following a [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] attack. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/fire-breaks-out-russian-port-after-ukrainian-attack-ferry-2024-08-22/ (Reuters)]
***The [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] announces an investigation of the [[Kursk Nuclear Power Plant]] following accusations from Russia that a Ukrainian [[One-way attack drone|drone]] targeted the power plant. **Suspected [[Boko Haram]] militants kill 13 farmers in [[Shiroro]], [[Niger State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/suspected-boko-haram-gunmen-kill-13-farmers-in-nigeria-3535096d (''Barron's'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
* The [[government of Botswana]] presents to the public a 2,492-carat [[raw diamond]], discovered by the [[Lucara Diamond|Lucara diamond and mining company]] from the [[Karowe diamond mine]], and said to be [[List of largest rough diamonds|the second largest in the world]]. [https://apnews.com/article/diamond-botswana-largest-carats-mining-0a736574d7cadaa8d9fe23c651ece97a (AP)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/aug/22/diamond-found-in-botswana-could-be-worlds-second-largest-gem (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2024 Canada railway shutdown]]
**[[Canadian National Railway]] and [[Canadian Pacific Kansas City]] lock out roughly 10,000 [[Trade union|unionized]] [[Rail transport|railroad workers]] in [[Canada]], leading to a railway stoppage that impacts many [[North America]]n [[supply chain]]s and may cost the [[economy of Canada]] [[Canadian dollar|C$]]341 million per day. [https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-transportation/canadian-national-railways-canadian-pacific-lock-out-teamsters-union-workers-2024-08-22/ (Reuters)]
**In response to the railway stoppage, [[Minister of Labour (Canada)|Canadian labour minister]] [[Steven MacKinnon]] refers the two disputes to [[binding arbitration]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/cn-railway-cpkc-lockout-job-action-negotiations-1.7301419 (CBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023–2024 South American drought]]
**[[2024 Brazil wildfires]]
***Nearly 1,500 [[Firefighter|firefighters]] are dispatched to contain intense wildfires that are causing dense hazardous smoke to fully "engulf" [[Porto Velho]], [[Rondônia]], [[Brazil]], with the total number of wildfires in Brazil reaching 59,000 since the start of the year. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/article/2024/aug/22/brazil-sends-1400-firefighters-to-the-amazon-amid-devastating-blazes (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Thai Flying Service Flight 209]]
**Nine people are killed when a [[Cessna 208 Caravan]] crashes into a mangrove forest in [[Chachoengsao]] shortly after taking off from  [[Suvarnabhumi Airport]] in [[Bangkok]], [[Thailand]]. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-plane-crash-cessna-chachoengsao-bangkok-airport-6997869f9000749f953fa5a54dc227ae (AP)] [https://www.nationthailand.com/news/general/40040814 (The Nation Thailand)]
*Eleven people are killed after a boat carrying migrants capsize while trying to cross the [[Drina]] [[river]] from [[Serbia]] to [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/death-toll-rises-11-after-boat-capsized-between-bosnia-serbia-media-say-2024-08-23/ (Reuters)]
*Seven people are killed and 12 others are injured after a fire at a hotel in [[Bucheon]], [[Gyeonggi Province]], [[South Korea]]. [https://www.nationthailand.com/news/world/40040844 (The Nation Thailand)]

**[[Burundi]] reports 171 new [[mpox]] cases, bringing the total number of cases in the country to 572 cases. [https://www.barrons.com/amp/news/burundi-records-171-mpox-cases-8aa9a896 (''Barron's'')]

**[[Belarus]] and [[China]] agree to greatly strengthen mutual trade, financial, energy, and security cooperation, which includes enhancing [[Supply chain|industrial supply chains]] and collaboration with the [[Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area|Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china-belarus-agree-strengthen-cooperation-trade-security-2024-08-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Treatment of women by the Taliban]]
**The [[Taliban]] bans women from singing, reciting poetry, or reading aloud in public and mandates that women must wear a [[veil]] in public under new laws approved by the [[Supreme Leader of Afghanistan|Supreme Leader]] as part of efforts to [[Enjoining good and forbidding wrong|combat "vice" and promote "virtue"]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/08/22/taliban-bans-women-s-voices-bare-faces-in-public-under-new-vice-laws-in-afghanistan (Al Arabiya)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Indonesian local election law protests]], [[2024 Indonesian local elections]]
**Thousands of people gather outside the [[House of Representatives (Indonesia)|House of Representatives]] in [[Jakarta]], [[Indonesia]], as well as in other major cities across the country, to protest attempted changes to local elections law that would benefit [[Advanced Indonesia Coalition|the ruling coalition]], in defiance of two recent [[Constitutional Court of Indonesia|Constitutional Court]] decisions. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8er13zy1gxo (BBC News)]
**[[Indonesian National Police|Police]] fire [[tear gas]] and [[water cannon]]s at protesters attempting to storm the House of Representatives, prompting the [[People's Consultative Assembly|Parliament]] to delay and eventually cancel the vote on the proposed changes. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-protest-jokowi-widodo-345949895cc83bd18abcd90f2d1a9715 (AP)]
*[[2024 Venezuelan presidential election]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Venezuela]] certifies the results of the 2024 [[President of Venezuela|presidential]] election, denying claims that [[Unitary Platform|opposition]] candidate [[Edmundo González Urrutia]] won the election. [https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-election-supreme-court-certifies-maduro-39d9f3b9beb0fe96fa052e4d2a3c106b (AP)]
*[[Human rights in Afghanistan]], [[Afghanistan and the United Nations]]
**The [[Taliban]] prohibits [[Richard Bennett (UN)|Richard Bennett]], the [[United Nations special rapporteur]] on [[human rights]] in [[Afghanistan]], from entering the country, accusing him of spreading propaganda. [https://www.dw.com/en/taliban-ban-un-human-rights-rapporteur-in-afghanistan/a-70011037 (DW)]
